result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 2 Division 40 (Special Events), covering insurance, cost recovery, enforcement and sales rules for special event permits, served from a page whose URL suggests a rent-pricing algorithm division but whose text contains no such provisions.
result.notes: No rules in the six in-scope categories appear in this part.
